neighbours.label: a preposition or locative word just after a place or object noun ('wall outside', 'lot of the store', 'bars on entrances')
fire: They hung the sign on the fence outside and went home.
Clean the rails and knobs on hospital doors weekly.
We met in the back room of the shop.
She lost a signal connecting to the tower.
He leaned his bike against the wall outside and left.
Wash the taps and handles on public sinks daily.
They waited in the front yard of the school.
I got a warning connecting to the printer.
quiet: They hung the sign very quickly and went home.
Clean the rails and knobs very carefully every week.
We met very late last night after work.
She lost a signal very early yesterday morning.
He leaned his bike very carefully and left.
Wash the taps and handles very carefully every day.
They waited very patiently until the bell rang.
I got a warning very late yesterday evening.

notes: Near misses keep the length and topic and drop the locative. A broad pole.
